definitions.explanation: Moving or happening at high speed. Written as {速|はや}い. Opposite of {遅|おそ}い (slow).
Happening before the expected or usual time. Written as {早|はや}い. Opposite of {遅|おそ}い (late).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{速|はや}い⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧{早|はや}く⟦{起|お}きました→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: I woke up early in the morning.

examples.japanese: {速|はや}く⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{早|はや}く⟦{寝|ね}た→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: You should go to bed early.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{速|はや}くて、⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This car is fast and feels good.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{早|はや}く⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わりました→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{早|はや}い⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{寝|ね}ます→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: I have an early start tomorrow, so I'm going to bed now.

notes:
Two different kanji share this reading, each with distinct meaning.

KANJI DISTINCTION:
- {速|はや}い: fast, quick (relates to speed)
- {早|はや}い: early (relates to time)

FORMS:
- Adverb: {速|はや}く / {早|はや}く
- Negative: {速|はや}く⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ / {早|はや}く⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧
- Past: {速|はや}かった / {早|はや}かった

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{速|はや}い: to be fast (at running)
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{速|はや}い: to work quickly
- ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧{早|はや}く: early in the morning
- 〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{早|はや}い: to be quick to do ~

USAGE:
- {早|はや}い frequently means "too early, premature," not merely "early": ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{早|はや}い (it is still too soon).
- The adverb {早|はや}く used alone functions as an urging "hurry up."
- {速|はや}い describes only rate of motion or work. It cannot replace {早|はや}い for clock time, so "the meeting is early" is {早|はや}い, never {速|はや}い.

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧ covers both meanings: slow and late.
